## Lab 7 Specifications

Lab 7 is the capstone Verilog design of the course: a full AES-128 hardware accelerator, partitioned into a datapath and controller and driven over SPI from the MCU. Because building a working accelerator on real hardware is a significant undertaking on top of a difficult specification, most of the grading weight is on getting the design to simulate correctly against the reference test vectors in the FIPS-197 standard; getting the design running end-to-end on the FPGA is an excellence-level stretch goal.

### Hardware Specifications

#### Proficiency

- [ ] SPI interconnect between the MCU and FPGA is wired correctly, matching the clock polarity and phase expected by the provided MCU code.

#### Excellence

- [ ] Design fits on the FPGA and completes a full SPI transaction, returning the correct ciphertext computed by the accelerator (not a value hardcoded or precomputed off-chip).
- [ ] SPI communication between the MCU and FPGA is displayed on the logic analyzer.

### Verilog Structure and Style Specifications

#### Proficiency

- [ ] AES logic is broken into modules for each major step (e.g., SubBytes, ShiftRows, MixColumns, AddRoundKey, KeyExpansion) rather than one monolithic block.
- [ ] Rounds are performed sequentially using a counter or FSM to sequence through them, rather than unrolled as one large block of combinational logic.
- [ ] Style conventions from previous labs (module names, descriptive variables, etc.) are still followed. See [HDL specs](../specs/hdl-specs.qmd)

#### Excellence

- [ ] Timing is correctly managed around the one-cycle latency of the synchronous RAM used for the sbox substitution.
- [ ] Finite state machines are implemented in an appropriate form discussed in lecture: canonical, non-canonical, or communicating.

### Simulation Specifications

#### Proficiency

- [ ] `testbench_aes_core` passes, verifying the `aes_core` module against the FIPS-197 test vector without the SPI link.
- [ ] Full system testbench (including the SPI link) passes, verifying the same test vector end-to-end.
- [ ] All simulations captured as legible waveform screenshots in the report.

### Other Documentation

#### Proficiency

- [ ] Report states which test vector(s) from FIPS-197 were used to verify the design.
